source: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles via AWS; SRTM, GMTED2010 and ETOPO1
resolution: zoom 12 within 15 km (~38 m), zoom 10 within 110 km (~153 m), zoom 8 beyond (~611 m)
method: Bilinear source sampling. 0.25-degree radial rays; 30 m distance steps to 15 km, 250 m to 100 km, 500 m to 500 km, 1 km to 1,000 km. Ocean elevations clamped to sea level. Approximate terrain visibility, not a survey.
reliefContext: Zoom-6 terrain (~2.4 km source pixels) fills the surrounding landscape beyond the detailed source coverage. Background only; visibility samples use zoom 8 or finer.
